source: Selected low-detail pixel blacksmith spirit with a single hammer
motion: Continuous independent head, eyes, shoulder/hammer and free-arm transforms; flame mesh deformation; strike-synchronized sparks; smooth forge recovery. Native 60Hz renderer. macOS Reduce Motion disables motion and particles.
review: Menu > 기본 동작 확인; preview uses a separate scene and never modifies real Codex session state.

interaction.technicalDebt: Prototype-only conservative opaque torso target. Replace with production sprite alpha-mask-derived input regions when detailed sprites are authored. Flame and outer silhouette are intentionally not interactive.

limitations: Basic motion review build. No mouse-following, typing-speed reactions, drag physics, or authored per-pixel flame-shape animation yet. Flame currently uses mesh deformation; no anvil or impact sound.
